newsitem.title: USA: McLeod files for up to 6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: McLeod files for up to 6 mln shares.

text.p: McLeod Inc said on Thursday that it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to six million Class A common shares.

Of the total, the company is selling 5,471,000 shares and certain stockholders are offering 529,000 shares, the filing said. After the offering, there will be 36,439,390 Class A shares and 15,625,929 Class B shares outstanding.

The underwriters have been offered an over-allotment option of up to 900,000 additional Class A common shares. The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers Inc, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to fund certain development and construction costs of the company's fiber optic network, market expansion activities of the telecommunications business and potential acquitisions, among others, the filing said.
The Cedar Rapids, Iowa-based company is a provider of integrated local and long-distance telecommunications services.
